hints.title: Dual Priority Structure Partitioning
hints.text: The median divides sorted window elements into two equal halves. Maintaining two priority structures allows retrieving the middle elements instantly.

hints.title: Two Heaps Size Balance Invariant
hints.text: The smaller half and larger half should remain balanced such that their sizes differ by at most one, with lazy removal discarding out-of-window elements.

hints.title: Balanced Window Insertion and Deletion Procedure
hints.text: Maintain a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half. Use a frequency table for lazy deletion of elements leaving the sliding window. When shifting, insert the new element, flag the departing element in the frequency table, rebalance the active heap sizes, purge invalid elements from heap tops, and record the median.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def medianSlidingWindow(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> List[float]:
        window = sorted(nums[:k])
        res = []
        is_odd = (k % 2 == 1)
        mid = k // 2

        def get_median():
            if is_odd:
                return float(window[mid])
            return (window[mid - 1] + window[mid]) / 2.0

        res.append(get_median())
        for i in range(k, len(nums)):
            leaving = nums[i - k]
            entering = nums[i]
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(window, leaving)
            window.pop(idx)
            bisect.insort(window, entering)
            res.append(get_median())

        return res
```

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * log K) time and O(K) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting every sliding window takes O(N * K * log K) or O(N * K), which is too slow for 50,000 items with large window k.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual heaps with lazy pruning achieve O(N * log K) time with O(K) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain two balanced heaps and handle lazy removal of expired window elements.
